protocol.experiment: experiment_1 — TPE · KDE+REINFORCE inversion · Lorentzian-width (TPA) · synthetic benchmark
protocol.benchmark: 14 synthetic exps (1nW/3nW × Trans05-100), true params from Gregor's fits; targets at true values, SYNTH_SEED=12345 (identical across trials); deterministic runs SEED=42
protocol.objective: combined relative MSE of (mu,gamma) over 28 per-exp errors + sampling SE; lower is better; no Fisher
protocol.space: space.json (parameters + dependencies) consumed by the AGHyperopt class (n_runs, n_iter, lr_mu, lr_gamma, sigma_ref, clip, gamma_anneal, h_s_min)
fixed_structural: mu LR linear decay no floor
protocol.authority: hyperparameters = agent's call within protocol; structural changes (score/likelihood/model) need Anuar's OK
open_decisions: budget 3.5h vs reduced benchmark vs tighter space
re-run baseline through harness for same-machinery anchor

trials.summary: Baseline: z-form gamma-score config (17g), computed from the executed 17g notebook (synthetic, 14 exps). mu rel-RMSE 3.6%, gamma rel-RMSE 4.3%. Objective to beat.
trials.key_insight: The 1/H^2 amplification was the gamma disease; one-power-of-bandwidth + fixed H_REF cures it on synthetic. Remaining: 3nW T05 gamma outlier (+2.14), mu bias at 3nW high-T.

trials.summary: trial_01 (2× lr_mu, σ_ref 8.2, mild γ-anneal, h_s_min up) ran the 14-exp benchmark in 70 min: objective 0.0049 ± 0.0021 — 3.1× worse than baseline, driven by sign-coherent μ overshoot on all 14 exps (rel-RMSE 8.6% vs 3.6%); 3nW T05 γ overshoot unchanged at +2.16.
trials.key_insight: μ overshoot that grows with drive plus a T05 γ overshoot that ignores both drive and anneal refute convergence starvation — these residuals are score/estimator artifacts, not hyperparameters to tune away.

trials.summary: trial_02 (per-step μ speed ≈ baseline via 36.4×(10/σ_ref 16.1)², 1.74× horizon, n_iter 348) ran the 14-exp benchmark in 186 min: objective 0.0031±0.0018 — 2.0× baseline (0.001578), 1.6× better than trial_01 (0.0049); μ still overshot all 14 exps (rel-RMSE 7.4% vs 3.6%), bias now concentrated in low-statistics Trans05/Trans10; γ rel-RMSE 2.6% (best so far), 3nW T05 γ 13.83 vs truth 14.1 (−0.27, trial_01's +2.16 attractor resolved).
trials.key_insight: Gentler-longer μ drive cured the high-T transient overshoot but left a drive-independent positive μ bias at low n_target — the μ score's fixed point sits above truth, so μ recovery needs a structural score change (σ_ref normalization / sample-size correction), not more hyperparameter tuning; γ needed no such fix.
